extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent agents, and patent office staff dealing with South African patent filings (including PCT national phase entrants)
extracted.subtask_description: Regulatory requirements and procedural standards for preparing, lodging, prosecuting and maintaining patent applications and patents under the Republic of South Africa Patents Act, 1978 (including PCT national phase and special rules for microbiological deposits). Covers required forms, document/layout standards, timelines, fees, and office procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and application of regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: These regulations shall apply to all patents and patent applications subject to the modifications set out in Chapter 1A in respect of international applications designating the Republic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic services: Registrar may require electronic filing
rubrics_metrics.description: The Registrar may direct by notice in the Gazette that any requirement under the Act or these regulations, including requirements in respect of information, records and payment, may or must be satisfied in electronic form, subject to the provisions of the operational requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational requirements published on the CIPRO portal set out the requirements, processes and procedures for electronic services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational requirements for electronic services (publication contents)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Registrar must publish operational requirements on the CIPRO portal setting out the requirements, processes and procedures in respect of all or certain electronic services, including registration procedures; identification, authentication and verification; form and format of records; manner and form of payment; information security requirements; and record retention requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational requirements may be published in different forms over different parts of the CIPRO portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic signature via CIPRO access code
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless another form of electronic signature is specified in the operating requirements, any signature requirement under the Act or these regulations in respect of a record to be accessed from or lodged with CIPRO is satisfied by the CIPRO customer entering his access code on the CIPRO system and any record lodged after the CIPRO customer having entered the access code shall be deemed to have been duly signed by the person whose signature is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is not necessary to record on such form that it had been signed if the signature is satisfied as above. CIPRO may accept the user as authorised unless prior written notification to disable the code has been received. CIPRO may suspend/terminate services with proper notice and without liability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees payable as prescribed in Schedule 1
rubrics_metrics.description: The fees to be paid in terms of the Act shall be the fees specified in Schedule 1 to these regulations and shall be payable in such manner as the registrar may direct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes specific fees (e.g., transmittal, international, search, renewal) referenced elsewhere in the regulations and schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of prescribed forms (Schedule 2) and modifications
rubrics_metrics.description: The forms referred to in these regulations are the forms contained in Schedule 2 hereto and such forms, whether in paper form or in any electronic form authorized by the registrar for electronic services, shall be used substantially in the manner prescribed for those cases to which they apply, but may be modified or amended with the approval of the registrar provided that such modifications or amendments shall not substantially affect their identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register entries (Form P2 particulars)
rubrics_metrics.description: The registrar shall cause to be entered in the register the particulars called for in Form P2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrar must maintain alphabetical indices of applicants, inventors, patentees and may maintain indices of assignees, licensees and hypothec holders; and maintain an index of granted patents according to classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office hours and extensions for last-day actions
rubrics_metrics.description: The office will be open to the public from Mondays to Fridays from 08h00 to 15h00 except on public holidays or days notified by placard. Whenever the last day fixed by the Act or regulations falls on a day the office is not open it is lawful to do the thing on the next following day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power of attorney filing (Form P3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any agent appointed to act on behalf of any person shall file a power of attorney on Form P3. On termination or change of authority an agent/principal must follow specified filing and notification procedures (e.g., new power, Form P4 to change address for service).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registration of an assignment does not revoke a prior power of attorney unless assignee files a new one. An agent may withdraw on notice to the registrar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address for service requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: On all documents lodged in terms of the Act there shall be stated the address for service of the person by or on behalf of whom the document has been lodged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any change of address for service shall be made by lodging Form P4.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections/alterations procedure (Form P4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any application or request to the registrar for the correction of an error in any document or for the alteration of any entry on a document or on the register shall be made on Form P4 (except where special forms are specified).

rubrics_metrics.name: Language requirement for documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Subject to the provisions of section 30(6)(c) of the Act, all documents other than drawings, priority documents or a specification lodged in terms of section 30(6)(a)(iii) shall be in one of the official languages of the Republic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document presentation and reproducibility
rubrics_metrics.description: All documents shall be so presented as to permit of direct reproduction by photography, reprography or electronic means in an unlimited number of copies. Paper sheets shall be free of cracks, creases and folds. Only one side of a sheet shall be used except where otherwise specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents not photocopies of other documents shall be on A4 paper (strong, pliable, smooth, matt and durable) or authorized electronic form. Each sheet short sides at top/bottom (except drawings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Margins, spacing and typographic standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Except for drawings, the minimum margins (which shall be kept completely blank) are Top: 20 mm; Left: 25 mm; Right: 15 mm; Bottom: 10 mm. In all original typed documents the typing shall be 1½ line spacing or double spacing. The capital letters used shall be not less than 2,1 mm high. All documents except drawings shall be in typescript or printed and in dark, durable colour.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units, symbols and technical terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Units of weight and measures shall be expressed in terms of the metric system (if different system used, also express in metric). Temperatures in degrees Celsius. Use symbols in general international practice; chemical and mathematical symbols commonly used. Use technical terms, signs and symbols generally accepted in the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification of formulas or symbols
rubrics_metrics.description: If a formula or symbol is used in the specification a copy of such formula or symbol, prepared in the same manner as drawings, shall be filed if the registrar so directs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legibility and freedom from alterations
rubrics_metrics.description: All documents, including drawings, shall be reasonably free from erasures and from alterations, overwritings and interlineations and shall, in any event, be legible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings: size, margins and layout
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings accompanying an application shall be on sheets of A4 size and the minimum margins shall be the same as those set out in regulation 15, except that below the top margin there shall be a space clear of any drawing matter to leave space for the name of the applicant, the application number and the numbering of the sheets and that at the bottom righthand corner there shall be a space within the margin ... for the signature of the applicant or his agent. All reference signs appearing on the drawing shall be simple and clear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings: paper and rendering standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings shall be on strong, pliable, smooth, matt and durable drawing paper or tracing cloth or in such electronic form as authorized; shall be executed without colouring in durable, black, sufficiently dense and dark, uniformly thick and well defined lines and strokes to permit of satisfactory reproduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application for grant: required documents (Form P1 and accompaniments)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application for a patent shall be made on Form P1 and shall be accompanied by: Form P1 (duplicate), Form P2 (duplicate), a declaration and power of attorney on Form P3, where applicant acquired right an assignment or proof to satisfaction of registrar, a single copy of a provisional specification on Form P6 or two copies of a complete specification on Form P7, drawings if necessary, and an abstract on Form P8 in duplicate if application accompanied by a complete specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convention application priority proof
rubrics_metrics.description: A convention application, if not made by the applicant in the convention country, shall also contain an assignment or other proof, to the satisfaction of the registrar, of the applicant's right to claim priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claiming priority to earlier domestic application
rubrics_metrics.description: An application claiming priority under the Act from any prior application to the patent office shall contain a copy, in duplicate, on Form P2 of such prior application as well as the specification lodged in support of such prior application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority document deposit timing and translation for convention apps
rubrics_metrics.description: A convention application shall contain a copy, certified to the satisfaction of the registrar, of the priority document. If in a non-official language, certified copy must be accompanied by a translation into an official language verified to satisfaction of registrar. Priority documents shall be lodged within six months of lodging the application or within such further period as the registrar may allow on request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional and complete specification commencement and signature
rubrics_metrics.description: A provisional specification shall commence on Form P6 and be continued on a new page with a description and signed at end of description by applicant or agent. A complete specification shall commence on Form P7 and shall be signed at the end thereof by an agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Microbiological inventions: deposit and disclosure requirements (28bis & 28A)
rubrics_metrics.description: A complete specification claiming a microbiological process or product where no samples of the micro-organism are available to the public shall only be deemed fully to describe the invention if before acceptance: (a) a culture has been deposited in a culture collection recognised by the EPO for rule 28 of the EPC implementing regulations; (b) the complete specification gives relevant information available to the applicant on the characteristics of the micro-organism; (c) the complete specification gives the date when the culture was deposited, the culture collection and the file number of the deposit. For certain claims, deposit with an international depositary authority under the Budapest Treaty is required at lodging, with name/accession number stated (or added before publication).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before acceptance applicant must furnish proof that samples are available to public in RSA. If accession number not in lodged specification it may be added before publication under section 50(1)(b). Communication of deposit information constitutes irrevocable consent to make culture available from the relevant date. Procedures exist for furnishing samples via Form P23 and Form P24 and undertakings to prevent third-party distribution until expiry/lapse of patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The title of an invention shall be as short and specific as possible and shall be descriptive of the nature of the invention claimed. Words such as 'improved', 'relating to' and the like shall not appear in the title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: Each category of claims (product, process, apparatus, use and the like) shall as far as practicable, be arranged in order of decreasing scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract content and length
rubrics_metrics.description: The abstract on Form P8 shall be that of the technical disclosure contained in the complete specification, but shall not be used to interpret the scope of the claims. It shall be in narrative form and generally limited to a single paragraph of not more than 150 words. The form and phraseology of patent claims shall be avoided. Features mentioned in the abstract and illustrated in the drawing may be followed by the reference sign used in that drawing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings with provisional specification: reproducibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings accompanying a provisional specification shall be capable of reproduction by photocopy or reprography.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration (Form P3) lodging time
rubrics_metrics.description: Form P3 shall be lodged within six months of the lodging of any application or within such further time as the registrar may on request allow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent of addition: complete specification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: An application in terms of section 39(1) for a patent of addition shall be made on Form P1 and shall be accompanied by a complete specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete specification of a patent of addition must set out the relationship between the invention in it and that in the complete specification of the main invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application to amend/lodge fresh application: required forms
rubrics_metrics.description: A fresh application under section 37 shall be made on Form P1 accompanied by a complete specification and a request for ante-dating on Form P4. An application under section 38(1) to change a complete specification to a provisional specification shall be made on Form P4. An application for post-dating shall be made on Form P4.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lodging of documents that were omitted at filing (Form P5)
rubrics_metrics.description: A document which did not accompany an application in terms of regulation 22(1) shall be lodged on Form P5.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests and applications to registrar (Form P4 in duplicate)
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless otherwise provided, any request or application to the registrar shall be made on Form P4 in duplicate quoting the section of the Act or regulation under which relief is sought and shall set out the relief claimed. The duplicate shall be returned to the applicant or agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination for legibility and formalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Any application accompanied by a provisional specification shall be examined to ensure that the documents lodged are legible and capable of reproduction. The registrar shall examine the application accompanied by a complete specification in order to ensure that it complies with the prescribed formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time to remedy defects (3 months)
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicant shall remedy any defect or comply with any direction under regulation 18, 22(2), 40 or 41 within a period of three months or within such further period as the registrar may on request allow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to comply within time may lead to application being treated as abandoned; applicant may request return of documents on Form P4 provided documents are not open to public inspection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance: registrar may accept when satisfied with formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: As soon as the registrar is satisfied that an application accompanied by a complete specification complies with the requirements of the Act, and unless there has been a request to delay acceptance, he may accept the application and give written notice thereof which shall be accompanied by Form P8.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant may request to delay acceptance to a date not later than 18 months from date of application; withdrawal of acceptance requires Form P4.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising acceptance in journal (timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: When notice of acceptance has been given by the registrar, the applicant shall advertise the acceptance in the journal within three months of such acceptance or within such further time as the registrar may allow on request on Form P4.

rubrics_metrics.name: Particulars of search reports (identification of cited documents)
rubrics_metrics.description: The prescribed particulars referred to in section 43(4)(a) shall be the full details required to identify all documents cited in a search report in respect of a patent application relating to the same subject matter lodged in another country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An application for these particulars shall be made on Form P4 in triplicate; Registrar forwards copy to patentee and returns a copy to applicant as receipt.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sealing of a patent
rubrics_metrics.description: A patent shall be sealed on the date of publication in the journal, in the form set out in Schedule 5 to these regulations or in such modified form as the registrar may direct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedule 5 contains the certificate text and format to be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Renewal fees and payment (Form P10)
rubrics_metrics.description: To keep the patent in force renewal fees set out in item 8 of Schedule 1 shall be paid by lodging Form P10 before the expiration of that year. All or any of the renewal fees may be paid in advance. A request for an extension of time to pay a renewal fee shall be made on Form P10 indicating reason for late payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restoration of lapsed patent (ex parte application)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application under section 47 of the Act for the restoration of a patent which has lapsed through non-payment of renewal fees shall be made by way of an ex parte application to the registrar in a form as near as possible to the form used for notice of motion proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If registrar is satisfied prima facie case made out he shall advertise the application once in the journal; any person may oppose restoration within two months of advertisement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of specifications: required forms
rubrics_metrics.description: An application to amend a provisional specification shall be made on Form P11. An application to amend a complete specification shall be made on Form P12 or P13, as the case may be, and a supplementary disclosure, if any, shall be made on Form P14.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If registrar is satisfied that Form P13 application complies he may direct advertisement once in journal; advertised application may be opposed within two months.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition proceedings before registrar: time limits and form
rubrics_metrics.description: Any person who has been notified of a proposed action by the registrar and who opposes such action or who opposes any such action advertised in the journal shall do so within two months of dispatch of such notification to him or within two months from the date of the relevant advertisement in the journal. Such opposition shall be lodged on Form P15, accompanied by any documents to be relied upon and proof of service on other parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Persons wishing to become parties may file a reply on Form P15 within two months of notification/advertisement. Registrar may appoint time/date to determine matter after replies or expiry of period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recording of assignments, licences and hypothecations (Form P16 and time limits)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application for the recording of an assignment shall be made in duplicate on Form P16 accompanied by proof of title. Such application shall be made within six months of the event entitling the applicant to request recording (registrar may extend on Form P4 and payment). A warrant or writ of execution or an attachment order shall be served at address for service and copy lodged with registrar on Form P16. An application to record a licence shall be made on Form P16 within six months of the event entitling recording or within six months of the grant if licence agreement was before such grant (registrar may extend on Form P4 and payment). Recording of hypothecation recorded in register on Form P16 accompanied by deed of hypothecation and served on relevant parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recording may be removed/cancelled on application to registrar on Form P4 with proof as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Endorsement/cancellation of endorsement of 'licences of right' (timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application for the endorsement or the cancellation of an endorsement of the words 'licences of right', in terms of sections 53 and 54 of the Act, shall be made on Form P4 within two months after the date giving rise to such endorsement or cancellation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voluntary surrender of patent (Form P21)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application for the surrender of a patent shall be made on Form P21.

rubrics_metrics.name: International applications (receiving office) — transmittal and PCT fees/time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: For international applications lodged with the patent office as receiving office the applicant shall pay the transmittal fee specified in Schedule 1 within one month of the date on which the international application was lodged, and the international fee and the search fee specified in PCT rules 15 and 16 within the time limits specified therein.

rubrics_metrics.name: National phase entry (Form P25 and timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: The national fee prescribed in section 43E(1)(a) shall be paid by the applicant on Form P25 in duplicate; the translation referred to in section 43E(1)(b) shall be lodged within six months of date of lodgement of Form P25. Within one month of complying with section 43E(1)(a) the applicant shall lodge Form P2; within six months of compliance (or further time allowed) the applicant shall lodge Form P3.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT national-phase time limits and required translation contents (31 months)
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the Republic has/has not been elected for international preliminary examination as relevant, the time limit applicable for entering the national phase shall be 31 months from the priority date (referred to article 2(xi) PCT). The required translation contents include description; claims (as amended under article 19 or by preliminary examination report as amended); and any textual matter on drawings, if any.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing translation of an amendment: registrar request
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the applicant fails to file a translation of an amendment referred to in regulation 67C or 67D, the registrar shall request the applicant to furnish the missing translation within a time limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Particulars / numerical references on patent documentation (Schedule 3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Schedules specify numerical references and minimum data elements to be used on patent documentation — e.g., document identification numbers, filing/priority dates, publication dates, IPC classification, title, keywords, list of prior art documents, abstracts, parties' names etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedule 3 lists mandatory fields and explains minimum data element for documents and journals (e.g., which dates meet the minimum requirement).
